description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, scenario-based medical exam questions with comprehensive explanations and references, tailored for different difficulty levels and content types.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based multiple-choice questions for medical exam preparation, tailored to difficulty level and content type.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality, accuracy, and appropriateness of a generated MCQ, including detailed scoring and issue identification.
